script_sections.title: Opening
script_sections.content:
Hello friends!

Today we are here because [CHILD'S NAME] is turning [AGE] — which officially means more candles, more cake, and a very important job for every guest: help us make this the loudest, kindest party of the week.

I am [HOST NAME]. Here's the plan: a welcome, a few games, songs and performances if anyone signed up, cake, and gifts at the end so we don't lose the wrapping paper in the first five minutes.

If you are a grown-up: you may sit. If you are a child: you may bounce, but please bounce away from the cake.

script_sections.title: Birthday Child Intro
script_sections.content:
Let's hear it for [CHILD'S NAME]!

[CHILD'S NAME] likes [HOBBY / FUN FACT]. Their current favourite song is probably whatever we are about to play. Their current favourite people are all of you — plus whoever brought the extra chips.

[CHILD'S NAME], wave to your friends. Friends, wave back like you practised.

script_sections.title: Segment Transitions
script_sections.content:
INTO GAMES: Energy is high. Good. Games first, cake second, so we don't play tag with icing on our hands.

INTO SONGS: If you submitted a song or a dance, you're up after this game. Parents, this is your warning to open the camera app.

INTO CAKE: When I say cake, please form a loose half-circle, not a rugby scrum. The birthday child blows the candles. Everyone else sings. Then we eat like we mean it.

script_sections.title: Closing / Cake & Thanks
script_sections.content:
Time for the birthday song and the cake.

[Happy Birthday / birthday song in your language]

Thank you, friends, for coming. Thank you, parents, for the drops and the patience. Thank you, [CHILD'S NAME], for being the reason we bought this many balloons.

Return gifts are at [PLACE]. Please say bye to [CHILD'S NAME] before you run to the car.

Happy birthday again. Go play — carefully!

songs.title: Happy Birthday
songs.note: The required number. Do it once, clearly, near the cake — not as background noise.

songs.title: If You're Happy and You Know It
songs.note: Warm-up while late kids arrive. Actions included.

songs.title: The Wheels on the Bus / local equivalent
songs.note: For younger crowds. Skip if the guest list is mostly 8+.

songs.title: Kid's favourite cartoon / film song
songs.note: Ask the birthday child in advance. Put this right before cake for a peak-energy moment.

activities.title: Pass the Parcel
activities.description: Music on, parcel moves. Music off, that child unwraps one layer. Keep layers equal to the number of kids if you can. No one should go home without a turn if possible.

activities.title: Statue / Freeze Dance
activities.description: Dance when the music plays, freeze when it stops. Last mover is out — or just laugh and restart if the group is young.

activities.title: Balloon Keep-Up
activities.description: One balloon, whole group, don't let it touch the floor. Add a second balloon when it looks too easy. Outdoor-friendly.

activities.title: Treasure Hunt (5 clues)
activities.description: Simple picture or one-line clues around the house/garden ending at a small prize box. Pair younger kids with an older buddy.

activities.title: Two Truths (kids version)
activities.description: Each volunteer: two true things ('I have a dog', 'I can whistle') and one fib. Friends guess. Keep it kind; host models a silly example first.
